{{translated title}} [[File:Pocket Monsters Premier 10.png|thumb|Logo]] '''''Pocket Monsters Premier 10''''' (Japanese: '''アニメ「ポケットモンスター」プレミア１０''' ''Anime "Pocket Monsters" Premier 10'') was a series of reruns of ten select episodes from past [[series]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} to commemorate its 20th anniversary following the theatrical release of [[M20]].
